title: A Resource Allocation Tournament
abstract: arXiv:2610.31418v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We introduce and analyze a round-robin simultaneous resource allocation contest, motivated by sports leagues and other competitive environments where agents must distribute limited resources across multiple encounters. Players allocate resources in advance to matches against all opponents, and match outcomes are determined by relative allocations. We study two payoff schemes: total points, where players accumulate rewards for each win, and winner-takes-all, where only the tournament winner is rewarded. For three players, we provide complete equilibrium characterizations under both schemes. For four or more players, we show that the total points payoff admits Blotto-type equilibria, while the winner-takes-all payoff requires numerical and algorithmic analysis. To address this, we develop a best-response dynamics algorithm with stochastic inertia and use it to approximate equilibria in games with four and five players.

translated_abstract: 我们引入并分析了一种循环赛制的同步资源分配竞赛，其动机来自体育联赛及其他竞争环境——在这些环境中，参与者必须在多场对抗中分配有限的资源。玩家提前为与所有对手的比赛分配资源，比赛结果由双方的相对分配量决定。我们研究了两种收益方案：总积分制，即玩家为每场胜利累积奖励；以及赢家通吃制，即只有锦标赛冠军才能获得奖励。对于三名玩家的情形，我们在两种方案下都给出了完整的均衡刻画。对于四名或更多玩家的情形，我们证明总积分收益方案存在Blotto型均衡，而赢家通吃收益方案则需要借助数值和算法分析。为解决这一问题，我们开发了一种带有随机惯性的最佳响应动态算法，并用它来近似四人和五人博弈中的均衡。
tldr: 该论文提出了循环赛制资源分配锦标赛模型，完整刻画了三人情形下总积分制与赢家通吃制的均衡，证明总积分制在四人及以上存在Blotto型均衡，并开发了带随机惯性的最佳响应动态算法来近似更高人数情形下的均衡。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a round-robin resource allocation tournament, provides complete equilibrium characterizations for three players under both total-points and winner-takes-all payoff schemes, shows Blotto-type equilibria exist for four or more players under total points, and develops a best-response dynamics algorithm with stochastic inertia to approximate equilibria in larger games.
